description:
Genes inside the Watkins introgression of a TK-NIL (Watkins segment in a Paragon background), with presence in
the Watkins donor and frequency in modern cultivars and landraces. nil_line is a NIL line name from
watkins_population_phenotypes (e.g. 'ParW141_0016-7-10-Q2D-Hd-P'). The interval comes from the NIL name
(chromosome-start-end on RefSeq v1.0). Highlights genes the donor lacks but most modern cultivars carry, and
genes the donor carries but most modern cultivars lack (Paragon itself is not in the pangenome).
name: watkins_nil_genes
